# OpenKanban

> OpenKanban is an open-source, board-based planner for projects and workflows, with boards, lists, cards, drag-and-drop movement, themes, and local-first browser storage. Part of OpenOak.

## Sibling OpenOak apps

- [OpenTodo](https://www.opentodo.org/): Open-source task manager: smart lists, quick capture, subtasks, search, themes, polished desktop and mobile. Available now, free.
- [OpenOutline](https://www.openoutline.org/): Structured open-source notes app for outlines, drafts, and reference material that stays easy to scan.

## About OpenOak

- [OpenOak](https://www.openoak.org/): The team behind OpenKanban. A small set of easy-to-use, open-source productivity tools that feel coherent, calm, and good to use. One account across all apps.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.openoak.org/legal/#privacy): No cookies, analytics, fingerprinting, ads, or tracking on the websites.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.openoak.org/legal/#terms): Code is open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Governed by Dutch and EU law.
